title: Loft square 20 to square 10, 20 up, Direction on both profiles (weight 1, angle 0)

expect.note: Each side line is a cubic leaving and meeting the profiles square to them with a derivative of 1 x 20 (weight x distance): the height is then z = 20 v and the square's side L = 20 - 10 (3 v^2 - 2 v^3); V = 20 integral L^2 dv = 20 (400 - 200 + 100 * 13/35).
